title: Subsidies for Fertility Screening and Introduction of New Category of Fertility Screening for Use of MediSave
what_it_is: Subsidies for Fertility Screening and Introduction of New Category of Fertility Screening for Use of MediSave

sections.label: Fertility screening subsidies and MediSave
sections.summary: Asked whether Government can subsidise fertility screening and add a MediSave category, with MOH reviewing financing schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Government can (i) provide subsidies for fertility screening and (ii) introduce a new specific category of fertility screening for the use of MediSave.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This helps to keep fertility tests affordable for all patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There are many requests for tests and treatments to be eligible for MediSave deduction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They need to be prioritised and carefully considered, to strike a balance between improving healthcare affordability, ensuring MediSave adequacy and keeping CPF contribution rates reasonable for all.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) will continue to review our financing schemes including MediSave to ensure fertility healthcare services remain affordable.

sections.label: Subsidies at specialist outpatient clinics
sections.summary: Medically indicated referrals to public healthcare specialist outpatient clinics get subsidies of up to 70%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I think that is important because then, you are sizing the subsidy and support for that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And when they are medically indicated and refer to the specialists outpatient clinics in our public healthcare institutions, they get subsidies and it is up to 70%.

sections.label: Guidelines for couples trying to conceive
sections.summary: Women under 35 trying for a year, and those above 35 trying six months, are encouraged to see a doctor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Already, as it stands, we have the guideline for couples, especially for women, who are below 35 years old, if they are below 35 years old and they have been trying to conceive for a year and have not been able to conceive, they are encouraged to go to see a doctor.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If they are above 35 years old and they have been trying to conceive for six months, they are asked to already go.

sections.label: No population-level fertility screening tests
sections.summary: There are currently no evidence-based population level fertility screening tests; testing is recommended when medically indicated.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, this is something that we continually review.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But, as it stands, currently, there are no evidence-based population level fertility screening tests because it makes more sense for the test to be ordered and recommended when they are medically indicated, rather than to give a screening to the whole group.
